name: UPS On Battery or Low Battery
description: Catches apcupsd and NUT (upsmon) notices for a power failure, running on battery, a low or exhausted battery, a battery that needs replacing and lost communication with the UPS. Power coming back is not matched.
match_pattern: Power failure|Running on UPS batteries|UPS \S+ on battery|UPS \S+ battery is low|Battery power exhausted|Reached run time limit on batteries|Battery charge below low limit|battery needs to be replaced|UPS battery must be replaced|Communications with UPS \S+ lost
